title: dev22 qualification and service-activation boundary
evidence: The systemd unit runs as rasenfalcon-ldap with NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict and dedicated state/runtime directories.
The daemon requires LDAPS TLS certificate/private-key paths and uses OpenSslLdapTlsProvider; plaintext LDAP is not a production fallback.
The daemon refuses startup unless the durable directory already contains ACTIVE resource:directory.
Credential material crosses the deployment boundary only through Secret Broker mappings from secretRef to environment-variable name.
non_claims: No target host installation is claimed.
No fresh ooRexx r13196 runtime PASS is claimed for dev22.
No live LDAPS bind/search/revoke or Crypto sign/verify/revoke acceptance is claimed.
No slapd, Dovecot, Postfix or Nginx substitution is part of the LDAP service contribution.
next_acceptance_gates: Build the Rasen Falcon identity role manifest from the sealed General Deployment dependency namespace.
Install rasenfalcon-ldap.service on the approved identity target with private-CA TLS and provisioned directory state.
Run ready:ldap_bind and e2e:ldap_revoke against the live owned service.
Have Crypto/PKI own and pass e2e:sign_verify_revoke; LDAP must not acquire signing authority.
